# Skistars vd om kvartalet – PPI tvingas höja bud

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-30  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon weighs a 'glass half full or half empty' market: US 10-year yields are at roughly 20-year highs and there are worries about midterms and AI capex returns, but oil is flowing again and earnings growth is strong. Guest Anders Breselius (Tellus Fonder) stays optimistic and highlights Nvidia, ASML, TSMC and Samsung Electronics as interesting entry points. Skistar's CEO presents a strong Q4 and full year with no property sales, plus a record booking position, and the stock rises about 7%. The hosts criticise PPI's bid structure, and the September winner and loser lists are reviewed.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SKIS-B — Skistar | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong Q4/full year with no property sales, summer business working, record winter booking position, extra week 53; stock +7%.

#### Reasoning

The CEO (management view, not independent) says summer is now profitable and the full-year margin of 17.5% was reached without property sales for the first time. The booking position is up 3%, the best ever, with Swedish consumers returning. The market reacted with a +4-7% move. Hosts were mildly positive but called the quarter seasonally unimportant.

#### Sell Triggers

- if winter bookings or snow conditions disappoint
- if lift-pass market share losses speed up
- if margin falls short of the 18% target

> *"Det är en väldigt stark rapport. Vi visar ju en kraftig tillväxt med 29 % i kvartalet."*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guest Breselius: rolling P/E 17-18, ~70% growth, margins above 70%, 'not expensive'; large position.

#### Reasoning

Guest fund manager Anders Breselius (Tellus Fonder) holds a large position. Valuations have fallen as profit estimates rose faster than prices, and he sees entry points after the Q3 reports.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex fails to earn a return
- if the capex cycle turns down around 2029
- if yields rise toward 6%

> *"Jag tycker Nvidia ser jättespännande ut, som är en stor position."*

---

### 🟢 ASML — ASML | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest: oligopoly with 80-90% share and the highest barriers to entry; looks interesting even though it is the most expensive.

#### Reasoning

Breselius (guest) points to ASML's dominant position in chip-making machines and its role as Europe's main AI exposure, while noting its premium valuation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex slows
- if valuation premium compresses

> *"ACML ser spännande ut."*

---

### 🟠 TSM — TSMC | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest lists TSMC among interesting AI names.

#### Reasoning

Breselius names TSMC as interesting, without a detailed case.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI demand slows

> *"TSMC, Samsung också, den har vi inte men den tittar vi lite på."*

---

### 🟠 005930.KS — Samsung Electronics | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Valued at half of Micron; guest finds it more interesting; Tellus is looking at it but holds none.

#### Reasoning

Relative value against Micron within the memory cycle; the guest is considering a position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the memory cycle turns down

> *"Samsung är på hälften. Jag tycker det är mer spännande."*

---

### 🔴 SINCH — Sinch | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Analyst view: Pareto started coverage with a sell rating; stock among the day's losers.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion (Pareto), not the hosts' own view. The new sell rating is weighing on the stock.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Pareto upgrades
- if Sinch reports a strong Q3

> *"Pareto har inlett bevakning av just Sinch med en säljrekommendation."*

---

### 🟢 SAVE — Nordnet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Analyst view: JP Morgan resumed coverage with overweight; stock up 3%.

#### Reasoning

Cited JP Morgan rating, not the hosts' own view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if trading activity falls
- if JP Morgan downgrades

> *"Rekommenderar övervikt för Nordnet."*

---

### 🟡 AZA — Avanza | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Analyst view: JP Morgan resumed coverage at neutral.

#### Reasoning

Cited JP Morgan neutral rating.

#### Sell Triggers

- if customer growth slows

> *"Behåll, eller neutralt ska jag säga, för Avanza."*

---

### ⛔ VOLCAR-B — Volvo Car | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Weak US and China sales; banks warn of a profit-warning risk before Q3.

#### Reasoning

Cited bank and analyst skepticism about a possible profit warning before Q3.

#### Sell Triggers

- n/a – reassess if Q3 beats expectations

> *"risken för en vinstvarning inför Q3-rapporten lyftes"*
